name: fixmycampus_final1
description: A full-stack campus complaint reporting application — students report issues (broken fans, water leakage, etc.), and campus admins triage, assign staff, and track resolution. Built to match the 13-screen UI design: Splash, Welcome, Login, Register, Student Home, Report Complaint, My Complaints, Complaint Details, Profile, Admin Login, Admin Dashboard, All Complaints, and Complaint Management.
